title: Actual profinite test maps and normalized derived direct-image composition
statement: For a scheme $X$ and profinite set $P$, let $X[P]=\operatorname{Spec}LC(P,\mathbf Z)\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}X$, with its actual projection $\pi_{X,P}:X[P]\to X$ [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects]. For a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ define $f[P]:X[P]\to Y[P]$ to be the actual map of fibre products with first component the first projection and second component $f\pi_{X,P}$. For a commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$ and the pulled-back internal modules [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], let $f^*$ be exact inverse image applied termwise and $Rf_*$ the ordinary unbounded K-injective total direct image, with their actual derived adjunction [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. For composable scheme maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$, define the canonical composition comparison $R(gf)_*\cong Rg_*Rf_*$ by conjugating the inverse pullback comparison $f^*g^*\cong(gf)^*$ under the actual composite adjunction and the adjunction for $gf$. This specifies an adjunction-normalized comparison, not an arbitrarily chosen isomorphism.
